resultados.pregunta: Considerando solo pedidos válidos, entre las categorías de producto con al menos 100 reseñas, ¿cuál tiene el mayor porcentaje de reseñas de 1 estrella y cuál es ese porcentaje?
resultados.sql_generado:
SELECT 
  t.product_category_name_english,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rv.review_id) AS reseñas,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT rv.review_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id)) * 100 AS porcentaje_1_estrella
FROM 
  order_reviews rv
  JOIN order_items oi ON rv.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE 
  rv.review_score = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT rv.review_id) >= 100
GROUP BY 
  t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
  reseñas DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categoria,
  ROUND(
    AVG(CASE WHEN r.review_score = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
    AVG(CASE WHEN r.review_score > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)
  , 2) AS porcentaje_1_estrella
FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_category_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY categoria
